   RisX-Security-Automation requests broad Graph API permissions. If credentials are compromised or the app is malicious, attackers gain impersonation capability over user data and mailbox contents.

4. **Limited Visibility**  
   Only 88 events across 3 days from a single source (Unified Audit Log). No sign-in logs, device compliance data, or conditional access events captured. Cannot rule out broader compromise or lateral movement.
